ZAF.note: Document states no national strategy, body, incident, designation or figures.

facts.fact: Michalsons states the President signed the Cybercrimes Act into law on 26 May 2021, while no separate cybersecurity bill or act exists.

ZAF.note: Document states no data localisation rule.
Cloud and information security directives are named without stating data location or classification rules.

facts.fact: Michalsons states the State Security Agency began engaging public and private sector stakeholders on the status of the Cybersecurity Bill in December 2023, with workshops planned for early 2024.
